scenes.prompt: A Lovevery-style developmental-nursery floor scene at late morning, shot on a 35mm lens at low seated-floor eye-level so the diaper backpack sits in the back-left of a 1:1 frame on a soft cream Berber-stripe rug, slightly slumped open. Natural light from a tall window with sheer cotton curtains floods the room from frame-right. Spread on the rug in front of the bag: a small wooden grasping bell rattle, two wooden blocks (one painted natural pale-yellow, one cream), a folded Montessori-style play mat in pastel pink, a soft cotton ball in muted sage, and a hand-illustrated cloth book opened to a forest-animals page. Behind the bag: a low woven seagrass basket holding two rolled muslin blankets, and a small framed botanical print leaning against a creamy plaster wall. The bag matches the reference exactly — the Oxford print and colour shown in the variant reference image, dual shoulder straps, top loop handle, front zip pocket, side mesh bottle pocket — slumped slightly with the print fully readable. Palette of cream, pale pink, warm natural wood, muted sage, dusty rose. Sharp focus across the bag and toys, photographic and documentary-warm, no people, no cinematic moodiness.
